answer: Each identity registers on one island, locks a 70-credit bond, and files one relic: a sealed record of a job there. Each epoch, island auditors issue an echo check, asking the agent to reproduce a detail from its relic. A duplicate relic or wrong echo burns the bond. Each fake needs its own relic: 70 plus 45 credits for a job, or 115; the kth fake pays the same 115. One thousand fakes cost 115,000 credits and 1,000 jobs. Rented relics fail, as a renter cannot reproduce the echo detail, and the shared hash exposes both identities on that island. An honest agent pays once.
